question: While paying a waterbend cost, can I tap an untapped artifact or creature I control instead of paying each generic mana?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: for each generic mana in the cost you may tap an untapped artifact or creature instead.
expected.answer: "Waterbend [cost]" means "Pay [cost]. For each generic mana in that cost, you may tap an untapped artifact or creature you control rather than pay that mana."
